Me, I am farming here in Mangochi a long time. This plot I keep for beans and some pigeon pea mixed together, because beans they put life back in the soil and my family needs relish. The fertilizer coupons from government, when I get them, I put on my maize plot — not here, because beans do not ask for much fertilizer. I have no money to buy extra bag, and the rains this year I am just hoping they come good. I will use the seed I kept from last harvest, and my children will help me weeding when school closes.
